snippet.title: MUPO - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. 

This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. 
Build levels, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. 
And there’s so much more to come—stay tuned.

WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM
